body.text: For every automation opportunity it identifies, the Borek AI Suite generates exactly one framework report like this. It is generated from the conversations with your team and is human-confirmed before it is the signed customer report. No consultant writes it. Every number in this report is traceable to its source. Estimates are shown as ranges with a confidence level, never as false precision.
